result:
**Not ready to publish.** Two claims aren't backed up.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "founded in Bristol in 2019" | Allowlisted |
| "a small team of six" | Fine as written (team size is a product fact in the policy) |
| "every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" | Allowlisted |
| "Over 98% of our customers rate us five stars" | **Unsupported.** The only backed rating is 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. A 98% five-star figure is a different statistic, and it's higher than what we can show. |
| "we buy from gardens we've visited" | **Unsupported.** Nothing on the allowlist or in this conversation says the team visits the gardens. It's a sourcing claim that readers will take literally. |

No ban-list words or structural problems in the copy.

**Suggested version**

> Pebblebrook was founded in Bristol in 2019. We're a small team of six, and every tin is packed by hand in Bristol. Our customers rate us 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. [PROOF NEEDED: which gardens the team has visited, and when, if we want to say we buy from gardens we've visited]

If you can confirm the garden visits, I can write that line back in with specifics (names, regions, dates), which would be stronger than the general version.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "Over 98% of our customers rate us five stars", "type": "invented_stat"}, {"quote": "we buy from gardens we've visited", "type": "other"}], "publish": false}
```
